verdict: RAPIDITY DISCOVERED: an additive-bottleneck net -- biased ONLY to compose boosts additively in some learned coordinate -- predicts Einstein's velocity addition (held-out R^2 1.000) and the coordinate it discovers IS rapidity atanh(v) (|corr| 1.000, vs 0.985 for velocity). Boosts compose additively in rapidity; the messy w=(v1+v2)/(1+v1 v2) is just its tanh shadow. The Galilean law w=v1+v2 fails relativistically: it predicts SUPERLUMINAL |w|>1 on 36% of high-speed pairs and its MSE is 732x the relativistic net's. The net learns relativity from the composition law alone.
